scenicChapters.title: Trabzon → Sultan Murat Plateau
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 63 km. 2200 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Turkey D915 Derebasi Bends
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2200 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

story: A 147 km loop that starts and ends near Trabzon, about 2 h 24 of riding. The stops in between: Sultan Murat Plateau and Uzungol. The highest point is about 2,200 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
